title: Self-hosted runner checkout hook killed after 30 minutes and the session setup fails
symptoms: Session setup fails after a long checkout hook
Checkout hook is stopped at 30 minutes
Large clones or slow bootstrap hooks fail on 2.1.307 but worked before
cause: From 2.1.307, checkout hooks on the self-hosted runner are stopped after 30 minutes by default, which fails the session setup. Earlier versions had no such limit.
fix: Raise --checkout-hook-timeout-min to a larger number of minutes, or set it to 0 to disable the limit.
affected: Claude Code self-hosted runner 2.1.307 and later
